units.source_text: 不过，大财主也不见得令人羡慕。

en.t: Still, even being very rich is not necessarily something to envy.

units.source_text: 你瞧松尾、片山，还不是得看他们本人的秉性吗？”

en.t: Look at Matsuo and Katayama; in the end, does it not depend on their own character?

units.source_text: （当时这个叫松尾的酿酒商和我的亲戚片山都破产了。）

en.t: At the time, a sake brewer named Matsuo and my relative Katayama had both gone bankrupt.
